title: Series and parallel results table
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 35 (Series and parallel results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 35: Series and parallel circuits. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To compare current in series and parallel circuits
equipment: A circuit kit or the portal simulation
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Build a series circuit with two lamps
Measure the current at three points
Build a parallel circuit with two lamps
Measure the current in the main wire and each branch
Explain the rule for each circuit

questions.q: Big question: how is a home wired so the fridge stays on?
questions.a: In parallel: each appliance has its own branch.
